name: KAST Card
summary: KAST is a stablecoin-first Visa card aimed at people who want to spend USDT and USDC without heavy verification. Onboarding is fast and the virtual card is issued instantly, though limits stay modest until you completeKYC.

kyc.notes: Email sign-up unlocks an instant virtual card with capped limits. A government ID is requested later to raise limits and to order the physical card.

pros: Instant virtual card after email sign-up
Stablecoin-first: USDT and USDC with no conversion guesswork
Up to 2% cashback paid in stablecoins
Apple Pay and Google Pay supported from day one
cons: Low spending limits until you complete KYC
Smaller coin list than multi-chain competitors
Physical card availability and ATM fees vary by tier

faq.question: Can I use KAST without KYC?
faq.answer: You can sign up with an email and get an instant virtual card with capped limits. Identity verification is required later to raise limits and order a physical card.

faq.question: What can I spend with the KAST card?
faq.answer: KAST is stablecoin-first and supports USDT, USDC and USDe across several networks. Spending is settled through a Visa card wherever Visa is accepted.

faq.question: Does KAST pay cashback?
faq.answer: KAST advertises cashback of up to 2% on eligible spend, paid in stablecoins. The exact rate depends on the tier and current promotions.

faq.question: Is the KAST physical card worth it?
faq.answer: The metal card adds a monthly fee, so it only pays off if you want ATM access or higher limits. The free virtual card is enough for most online spending.

availabilityNotes: KAST availability varies by region. Confirm your country during sign-up before completing KYC.
